summary: Volkin outlines his summon strategy between the First Blush and Wish Summon banners on a Season 1 account. He opts to pull to the 150 milestone on First Blush to secure guaranteed heroes for both Summoner and Toxin teams at lower pull thresholds. The First Blush banner offers guaranteed selected heroes at 50, 100, and 150 pulls rather than requiring 300 pulls like the Wish Summon. During the summons, he reaches pity on regular pulls, securing Sintrellia, Twitch, and Lelwanis from milestones, while pulling Jathalea and a Torrin duplicate from standard pity.

heroes.name: Lelwanis
heroes.note: Consumes battlefield summons to gain stacks, transforming into an extremely durable, high-damage dragon at 20 stacks.

heroes.name: Sintrellia
heroes.note: Duplicates your team's strongest summon and directly buffs Lelwanis when Lelwanis is transformed into a dragon.

heroes.name: Twitch
heroes.note: A vital core DPS pick needed to complete and optimize Toxin/Poison team compositions.

heroes.name: Jathalea
heroes.note: Described as 'spud cakes' and not considered a good legendary to pull or invest in.

heroes.name: Anneliesis
heroes.note: An exclusive Aura support from CN servers who fits into any team and is worth saving 300 summons for if she arrives globally.

teams.note: Sintrellia provides summon duplication and direct dragon buffs while Lelwanis consumes summons to transform and carry.

tips: Be careful when choosing heroes on the First Blush banner: once you confirm and lock in your choices, they cannot be changed.
First Blush is much more accessible for low spenders and F2P, giving guaranteed heroes at 50, 100, and 150 pulls compared to Wish Summon's 300-pull requirement.
First Blush milestones grant the chosen hero directly rather than bonus summon dice like some other special banners.
Plan around hitting worst-case pity (70 pulls) rather than hoping for early legendary luck.
title: F2P Summons For My NEW TEAM!!! [Dragonheir: Silent Gods]
